name: leccor-finance-flow
description: Assistente financeiro pessoal conversacional com IA e Google Sheets.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @leccor/contracts build && pnpm --filter @leccor/backend build && pnpm --filter @leccor/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @leccor/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @leccor/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @leccor/frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @leccor/contracts test && pnpm --filter @leccor/backend test && pnpm --filter @leccor/frontend test
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
